_comment: CONTROL ARM. The reference pad's regime: token-only, ZERO quote seeded. This is the profile the bot
fleet skips, and the one TROLLCAT was launched in. Identical to the treatment arm on supply, seeded
token amount, fee, opening tick and every recipient - the range is token-only because a position
holding no quote cannot straddle spot.
NAME AND SYMBOL ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE TREATMENT ARM AND MUST STAY THAT WAY. They are what a
human, a scanner and a sniper bot READ, so an arm-specific symbol would put the treatment label on
the token itself and confound the dependent variable with the assignment. Distinctness of the
deployed token addresses comes entirely from the CREATE2 salt block run-arm.js derives from armId.
PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION: treatment draws a fast-flip buyer within 1,000 blocks; control does not.
By the rule of three, 0 hits in 8 controls bounds the control rate below ~31% at 95%.

OPENING TICK 253000 is CALIBRATED, not chosen: at a full range 1 WETH pairs with 1.0001^tick tokens, so matching the observed 1 WETH / 98e9 profile forces tick ~253093, aligned to 253000. A fork rehearsal at tick 206800 seeded only 9.57e8 tokens - 100x short - which would have made the arms differ on token amount as well as quote.
declaredTx: fill in the declareExperiment transaction hash once it is mined; it must match the
treatment arm's, because there is ONE declaration for the experiment, not one per arm.
